en: Black-and-white vintage postcard showing a panoramic view over the rooftops and gabled townhouses of Meissen. In the foreground is a historic market square area with stepped-gable facades. On the hill in the background stand large historic buildings and a church with a tall spire; next to it a large tower-like structure is covered in scaffolding. The caption in red at the lower left reads "Meissen. Blick vom Stadtturm." The publisher line at the bottom margin says it was produced by Brück & Sohn in 1905.
